# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 76 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Nonogram** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/nonogram/), a free online logic-grid pixel puzzle game — read the row and column clues, deduce the hidden picture, and fill it cell by cell, from 5×5 to 15×15, all in the browser, **Flexbox Playground** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/flexbox-playground/), a free online flexbox playground — toggle every container and item property, watch the boxes obey live, and copy the generated CSS, all in the browser, **Shadow Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/shadow-generator/), a free online box-shadow designer — drag sliders for offset, blur, spread and opacity, pick a preset, and copy the CSS, all in the browser, **NFT Rarity Calculator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/nft-rarity/), a free online NFT rarity calculator — paste a trait collection as JSON and get trait frequencies, rarity scores and a ranked leaderboard, all computed locally, **White Noise** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/white-noise/), a free online white noise mixer — blend white, pink and brown noise, rain and ocean sounds generated live in your browser, with per-sound volumes and a sleep timer, **Uniswap v3 LP Simulator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/lp-simulator/), a free online DeFi simulator — pick a price range and fee tier, run a seeded price path, and compare fees, impermanent loss and value against simply holding, all simulated data, **Rock Paper Scissors** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/rock-paper-scissors/), a free online rock paper scissors game — play a best-of-five match against a bot that counters your most-played move, first to 3 wins, all in the browser, **Gradient Studio** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/gradient-studio/), a free online gradient studio — layer colours and stops, set the angle, preview live, and copy the CSS, all in the browser, **Easing Visualizer** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/easing-visualizer/), a free online easing visualizer — drag cubic-bezier control points, preview the animation, and copy the CSS for your transition, all in the browser, **Token Vesting Visualizer** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/vesting-visualizer/), a free online token vesting visualizer — enter a cliff and linear unlock schedule to see exactly when tokens unlock month by month, all computed locally,
